description: Octane on the multi-threaded Tokio runtime with its own HTTP/1.x parser, default configuration. Routes and path parameters through the octane router, query parameters through req.get_query(), bodies read whole from req.body (Content-Length or chunked), JSON serialized per request with serde_json through res.json. TLS on :8081 through rustls (ring), ALPN http/1.1. /delay is an async handler waiting on tokio::time::sleep, the rest are synchronous handlers. max_connections raised to 65,536 for the held-connection profiles.
